title: 1972 RAND very high-speed transit system study

tellings.quote: in like 5 minutes. Uh there's the 1972 uh Rand theoretical study, the very high-speed transit system

plain: A researcher known online as UAPGerb points the podcast host Jesse Michels to a 1972 study by RAND, a research organization that does work for the US government. He says it was a theoretical design for a "very high-speed transit system" that could move people across great distances in minutes. He brings it up as an example of advanced travel ideas that were already being studied decades ago.
